title: Twin Turboprop Takeover! Carenado Saab 340B & Piper Cheyenne III | MSFS 2020 Marketplace
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a dedicated twin-turboprop wave of brand-new aircraft arrivals on the MSFS 2020 Marketplace—spanning regional airline passenger and freight operations up to high-altitude executive charter flying.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect these new Marketplace releases and detail what each developer brings to the platform:

Microsoft & Carenado Saab 340B: The Swedish regional workhorse officially crosses over to MSFS 2020! Featuring General Electric CT7 turboprop engines, a 25,000 ft service ceiling, and an 870 km operational range, this package brings both passenger (up to 34 seats) and cargo configurations (carrying up to 7,500 lbs of freight). We inspect the included liveries, cockpit detail, and edition-upgrade discounts that make this an accessible twin-turboprop addition.

Propair Flight Piper Cheyenne III: A high-fidelity, twin-engine corporate turboprop built for high-performance cross-country flying. We take a close look at the detailed steam gauge flight deck with realistic wear and tear, custom Electronic Flight Bag (EFB), and liveries. Plus, we evaluate the included SkyPass type rating and training program credits that help justify its premium price tag.

Whether you are scheduling regional commuter hops in the Saab 340B or managing fast corporate runs in the Cheyenne III, we evaluate this ramp inspection to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Are you picking up the Saab 340B or taking the Cheyenne III into the skies?
